officialTitle: Why Leaders Should Use AI Themselves and Eat Their Own Dog Food?

chapters.title: Introduction: why leaders need firsthand AI experience
Using AI to build tools for leadership
A Jira mistake: permissions, logging and guardrails
Making time for learning and setting priorities
Treating AI assets as a product
Six lessons and a path to better leadership

existingSummary: Jenni Kylmäkoski shares what she learned by using AI to build her own leadership tools at Nokia: improving developer experience, making time to learn, adding guardrails and treating AI assets as maintained products. A Jira mishap illustrates why firsthand experience matters for leading the change.
